title: T1 re-bless rewrites every tick line — the juice diff (1400/1400 lines) is un-reviewable at line level by design
evidence:
goldens/juice.t1 header: "catalog_hash 250679b1940fb87b" / "ticks 1400" (all 1400 per-tick lines changed in the diff). core/serialize.odin: "w_u8(&w, state.era)
	w_u64(&w, state.catalog_hash)
	w_i32(&w, state.logic_hz)" — catalog_hash rides every per-tick T1 hash, so the fold shifts every tick even where behavior is byte-identical (juice has no `growth on`, no small_biz/campus terminals, and its T2 pngs were deliberately untouched in a2dc66e). harness/manifest.odin: "fmt.sbprintf(&sb, "t1 1\ndemo %s\nseed %d\nlogic_hz %d\ncatalog_hash %016x\nticks %d\n",
		demo_name, demo.seed, logic_hz, catalog_hash, len(hashes))".
detail: Every catalog fold churns all 35 .t1 files wholesale; a reviewer cannot line-verify 1400 hashes, so correctness rests entirely on the PR's cause-chain docs and the replay gate, not the diff itself. Deliberate ODN-11 binding, but a recurring review-cost property this chunk exemplifies.
recommended_fix: None required (deliberate design). Keep the pattern used here: fold-only proof, log byte-diff evidence (bytes 17-24), and consistent catalog_hash across the whole suite in the PR so the re-bless is verifiable without re-running the harness.
